# Tanishq Singh

> Tanishq Singh is a software developer and the publisher of a public security research and assessment resource focused on Shadow AI detection, enterprise AI agents, and AI agent security.

This site contains a free, self-guided Shadow AI Detection Assessment for understanding reported enterprise control coverage across AI agent discovery, identity and access, runtime controls, data protection, and governance.

The assessment is based only on user-provided responses. It is a screening tool and does not constitute a penetration test, technical security audit, or independent validation of an organization's environment.

## Assessment

- [Shadow AI Detection Assessment](https://tanishqsingh.in/shadow-ai-assessment/): A 12-question, 24-point self-assessment covering discovery, identity and access, runtime controls, data protection, and governance for enterprise AI agents.
- [Assessment sitemap](https://tanishqsingh.in/seo/sitemap-pages.xml): Canonical page index for the site, including the Shadow AI Detection Assessment.
